# Leaflet 1.9.4
- Source: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js and leaflet.css
- Documentation: https://leafletjs.com/examples/quick-start/
- License: BSD-2-Clause, see LEAFLET-LICENSE.

# OpenStreetMap
- Browser tile source: https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png
- Attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, shown on the map.
- Copyright: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
- Usage policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
- Tiles are loaded by the browser only for the visible map. No offline tile archive is bundled.
